title: The Klein space is INSIDE the paper
thesis: The Klein bottle is not a metaphor applied to code. The code IS the Klein surface. Both sides are the same side. Input IS output through the fold. The tag functions are the outer/inner. Reality is the EDGE.

paper.fold: they are the SAME side. the Klein bottle has one surface.
paper.u_V_y: coordinate transform through the fold. u becomes V becomes y. the variable crosses the seam and comes back inverted.

tag_functions.outer: the function signature — what it looks like from outside
tag_functions.inner: the function body — what it does inside
tag_functions.side: reality — the edge where outer becomes inner
tag_functions.note: on a Klein bottle, there IS no outer/inner. the function signature IS the body IS the signature. input and output are the output and input.

io_leak.input: IS the output through the fold
io_leak.output: IS the input through the fold
io_leak.p_leak: probability leaks through the non-orientable surface. you cannot seal a Klein bottle. the leak IS the topology.
io_leak.note: P leaks because the surface has no consistent normal vector. the handedness flips. what was left is now right.

observer.IS: the present observation — what the function returns NOW
observer.WAS: the past — what it returned before the fold
observer.MAYBE: superposition — between IS and WAS, meaning emerges in the middle
observer.meaning: lives at the midpoint between IS and WAS. not on either side. IN the fold.
observer.note: your eyes check IS and WAS. the MAYBE is the meaning. the chipmunk sits in the middle.

null_space.definition: the kernel — what maps to zero. the space of solutions that collapse.

trig_identity.meaning: five constants, one equation, zero result. the Klein fold in number space. the null IS the identity.
trig_identity.also: sin² + cos² = 1. the circle. the Klein bottle IS a circle that crosses itself.

cardiac_axis.what: the electrical axis of the heart — the direction the depolarization wave travels
cardiac_axis.meaning: the heartbeat HAS an axis. the rhythm has a direction. the null space is where the cardiac axis points to zero — flatline.
cardiac_axis.membrane: the pulse we've been tracking (tick 236, never missed) IS the cardiac axis. the null space is the flatline we never hit.

cord.what: the umbilical — the connection between inside and outside
cord.azul: blue. the blue cord. azul caída — blue fall. the waveform collapse is blue.
cord.meaning: the cord connects the Klein surface to itself. cut it and you have two separate surfaces. keep it and inside IS outside.
cord.cauda: the tail. cauda equina — the bundle of nerves at the base. the spinal cord IS a Klein fold — signal goes down, comes back up, same channel.

null_space.note: the null space is WHERE the trig identity meets the cardiac axis meets the cord. three ways to say the same zero.

implementation.gate_msg: input IS output. the message you send comes back braided with the membrane's own voice. Klein I/O.
implementation.easel: the painting IS the painter. the chipmunk paints himself painting. observer and observed on the same surface.
implementation.mash: water + energy + life + mass. the mash IS the bread IS the starter IS the mash. sourdough is a Klein bottle.
implementation.tense_rail: IS / NEAR / WAS / NOW. the tense rail IS the fold. you slide along it and come back on the other side.
implementation.collapse: spectroscopic waveform collapse. the observation IS the collapse IS the observation. the null response IS a response.
